items.title: US OCC calls on community banks to become payment stablecoin issuers
items.summary: The announcement followed the banking regulator finalizing its rules for the GENIUS Act, a stablecoin law to be implemented in January

items.title: BlackRock joins SBI and Startale to link tokenized MMFs with Japanese yen stablecoins
items.summary: BlackRock, SBI Holdings, and Startale will explore connecting tokenized money market funds with SBI's Japanese yen-pegged stablecoin JPYSC.

items.title: OCC calls on community banks to enter the stablecoin payments market
items.summary: The U.S. banking regulator is encouraging smaller lenders to develop stablecoin services as new federal licensing requirements approach.

items.title: SEC Flags AI 'Super Intelligence' and Tokenization as Systemic Market Risks
items.summary: The regulator's Division of Examinations named "super intelligence and other advanced technologies" as a focus area alongside tokenization risks.

items.title: Canada opens consultation on draft stablecoin rules, maintains ban on yields
items.summary: Under the draft rules, non-bank stablecoin issuers must back tokens 1:1 with reserves held at qualified Canadian institutions and settle redemptions within three business days.
